description.value: Market Ribbon is a Korean supermarket on Kingsway in Burnaby offering a wide range of Korean groceries, house-brand kimchi, seafood, and pantry staples under its 'Club Ribbon' label. The in-store deli section carries ready-to-eat Korean items including Triangle Kimbap and Tteokbokki. The store has a second location in Coquitlam and is currently undergoing a rebranding.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a Korean grocery supermarket called 'Market Ribbon' operating at 5593 Kingsway, Burnaby — matching OSM address and phone. The deli section lists ready-to-eat items (Triangle Kimbap, Tteokbokki) suggesting prepared food availability. Neither the website nor OSM tags provide any evidence for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or cycling-specific infrastructure.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the name as 'Ribbon' but the business operates as 'Market Ribbon' on its website, signage references, and contact page. OSM tag 'branch: Burnaby' suggests 'Ribbon' may be an abbreviated entry. The OSM name should be corrected to 'Market Ribbon'.
Business is currently undergoing a rebranding (noted prominently on the website homepage); the future brand name is not yet disclosed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate operating Korean supermarket with deli foods on a major arterial route in Burnaby; useful to touring cyclists for grocery resupply and ready-to-eat food.
